ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a galvanic cell apparatus: there is an Ag electrode in the beaker on the left, and the solution is labeled 1.0 M AgNO3; there is a Sn electrode in the beaker on the right, and the solution is labeled 1.0 M Sn(NO3)2; there is a salt bridge between the two beakers, and a voltmeter is connected above. The standard reduction potential table below the figure gives: Ag+ + e− → Ag(s), E° = +0.80 V; Sn2+ + 2e− → Sn(s), E° = −0.14 V. From the figure, the cell notation can be established: Sn(s) | Sn2+(1.0 M) || Ag+(1.0 M) | Ag(s). Comparing standard reduction potentials, the +0.80 V of Ag+/Ag is larger, so Ag+ is reduced at the cathode; the −0.14 V of Sn2+/Sn is smaller, so Sn(s) is oxidized at the anode. Substitute into the formula E°cell = E°cathode − E°anode = 0.80 − (−0.14) = 0.94 V.

raw_record.question_text: According to the given circuit diagram, establish the corresponding power supply unit. Calculate the numerical value of the total electromotive force $e^{\circ}_{\mathrm{cell}}$ (V) of this power supply unit.

method.method_draft: 先从图像识别并建立电池：Sn(s) | Sn2+(1.0 M) || Ag+(1.0 M) | Ag(s)。比较表中标准还原电势，Ag+/Ag 的 +0.80 V 大于 Sn2+/Sn 的 −0.14 V，因此 Ag+ 在阴极被还原，Sn 在阳极被氧化。代入 E°cell = E°cathode − E°anode = 0.80 − (−0.14)，得到总电动势 0.94 V。
method.CoT_raw: 图像显示一个原电池装置：左侧烧杯中有 Ag 电极，溶液标注为 1.0 M AgNO3；右侧烧杯中有 Sn 电极，溶液标注为 1.0 M Sn(NO3)2；两烧杯之间有盐桥，上方连接电压表。图下方的标准还原电势表给出：Ag+ + e− → Ag(s), E° = +0.80 V；Sn2+ + 2e− → Sn(s), E° = −0.14 V。由图可建立电池表示式：Sn(s) | Sn2+(1.0 M) || Ag+(1.0 M) | Ag(s)。比较标准还原电势，Ag+/Ag 的 +0.80 V 较大，因此 Ag+ 在阴极被还原；Sn2+/Sn 的 −0.14 V 较小，因此 Sn(s) 在阳极被氧化。代入公式 E°cell = E°cathode − E°anode = 0.80 − (−0.14) = 0.94 V。
